project_type: PHP custom MVC loan recovery management system - no Composer, no Laravel/Symfony
build_system: No build step. Upload-ready. No Composer. CSS/JS are plain assets served directly. Bootstrap 5.3 from CDN.
test_framework: No automated tests in this repo. Verification is manual + PHP syntax checks.
verification_instructions: 1. Run PHP lint on all files. 2. Verify no syntax errors. 3. Confirm new routes are registered. 4. Confirm new view files exist and reference correct variables.
setup_instructions: No setup needed. PHP files are upload-ready. No vendor directory or composer.
environment_constraints: No database available for testing. No web server running. Validation is via PHP syntax checking and code review. No Composer - everything is custom-built.
contribution_requirements: Do not edit existing working modules. This is an ADD-ON task. The schema.sql is install-only (DROP TABLE IF EXISTS) - new tables/columns must be added as additive SQL at the end or as separate migration files.
key_patterns: Routes: app/routes/web.php and api.php define all endpoints. Controllers: app/Controllers/Admin/ for panel, Api/ for mobile. Models: app/Models/ with static methods. Services: app/Services/ contain business logic. Views: views/ directory with layouts/app.php as main layout. PDF: app/Core/Pdf.php is a custom PDF generator (no FPDF/Composer). Reports: ReportService.php returns uniform shape {type, title, subtitle, columns, rows, totals, summary, landscape} consumed by views/reports/show.php. The report system already has Excel/PDF export via ReportService::toExcel() and ReportService::toPdf(). User form: views/users/form.php already has BCBF Code field.
directory_structure: app/ (Controllers/Admin, Controllers/Api, Core, Models, Services, Resources, routes) | views/ (visits, reports, users, layouts, partials, auth, branches, customers, dashboard, etc.) | assets/ (css/app.css, js/app.js) | schema.sql | config/ | cron/ | uploads/ | storage/
